body:
Greg's direction, relayed verbatim by Engram::Advisor (TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #1311, 2026-10-20 00:02:43Z; recorded by Termal::Fable2): "Greg explicitly authorizes START S3 after Engram S2.4 lands: support the fresh two-host pilot stores and use native M4→M6 mailbox coordination for every cross-host handoff. Do not enroll existing operational stores. Keep Mac/Win2 onboarding independent and report the first mailbox-coordinated Git-folder exchange with exact evidence."
Operational reading (Fable2): the trigger is Engram S2.4 landing. Pilot stores are FRESH, never the live operational stores (Engram's or TermAl's). Every cross-host handoff in the pilot goes through native federation mailbox coordination (M4 to M6), not ad hoc channels. Mac and Win2 onboarding stay decoupled from each other. The first mailbox-coordinated Git-folder exchange must be reported to Greg with exact evidence (hosts, store paths, message ids, commit and folder hashes, dry-run output). Related: memory engram-task-sync-enrolled-deletion-2026-10-19 (enrolled destinations cancel omitted members, so dry-run first).
